messaging.title: Find a chat and read it
messaging.when: You need the recent messages of one person or group.

steps.note: Find the chat by name with query; keep its chat_id.
Read the newest messages of that chat_id; pass before with the oldest message seen to page back.

messaging.title: Search messages and open one in context
messaging.when: You know words of a message but not its chat.

steps.note: Search the words; narrow with accounts, chats or from_time/to_time.
Open a hit by its message_id to read the messages around it.

messaging.title: Send a message safely
messaging.when: The owner asked you to write to someone.

steps.note: Preview: dry_run true returns recipient, text, warnings and a confirm_token; nothing is sent.
Show the owner the preview, get their exact yes, then send the same to and text with confirm_token.
Follow the reply: read the chat_id from the result later. On state unknown read here first and never resend.

messaging.title: Answer the chats waiting for a reply
messaging.when: The owner asks what needs an answer.

steps.note: List chats whose last message waits for the owner's reply.
Read each chat that matters before suggesting a reply.
Draft with dry_run true and send only after the owner's exact yes, as in send_safely.

messaging.title: Read a Telegram bot's buttons, then press one
messaging.when: A bot's message offers inline buttons and the owner asks what they are or to press one.

steps.note: Find the bot's message in its chat; keep chat_id, message_id and its revision.
Read the live keyboard: operation inspect_message_buttons, a new request_id. Keep each button's row, column, label and fp.
Preview the press: operation press_button, dry_run true, parameters row, column, label and fp from the inspection. Nothing is pressed.
Show the owner the preview; after their exact yes repeat the same arguments with dry_run false, its preview_digest and one request_id.
Read the receipt by operation_id. On submitted or unknown never press again; check the chat first.

calendar.title: Find a free slot for several people
calendar.when: You need a time that suits the owner and family members.

steps.note: Look up member names when unsure who people means.
Ask for free times in a window; each slot carries a next call to schedule it.

calendar.title: Plan and apply an event change
calendar.when: The owner asks to move, change or cancel an event.

steps.note: List calendars and keep the calendar_ref values.
Read the agenda for the day to find the event_ref.
Prepare the change: a preview and field diff with a plan_id; nothing changes yet.
Show the owner the preview; apply plan_id with a new request_id only after their yes.

calls.title: Place one call and read its result
calls.when: The owner asked you to call someone about one task.

steps.note: Preflight with dry_run true: no dialing; it returns a confirm_token.
After the owner's exact yes, place the call with the same request and confirm_token; keep call_id.
Wait for the outcome with call_id and wait_s; never retry an unknown outcome.

android.title: Run a saved flow and read its result
android.when: A published flow does the task on the phone.

steps.note: Pick the device_id.
Acquire the device with action acquire; keep the session_id.
List saved flows to find the name and published version.
Run the flow by name with a new request_id and the session_id.
On running or unknown, poll the request_id for the result.
Release the session with action release when done.
